LESSON: MIXTURES

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade five
Subject: HEARING IMPAIRMENT SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY
Strand: Matter
Topic 2.1: Mixtures
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 14

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Mixtures, part of Matter in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade five HEARING IMPAIRMENT SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY.

Key inquiry question: What should be considered when separating various mixtures? 2. How do we separate mixtures?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Mixtures together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and collaboration: The learner contributes to team decision making as they separate mixtures using

appropriate methods.

• Learning to learn: The learner reflects on their own experiences as they carry out activities with peers to separate different

types of mixtures.

16

Values:
● Social justice: The learner gives others equal opportunities in sharing responsibilities as they work when separating mixtures.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

● Social-economic issues (financial literacy): The learner appreciates applications of separating mixtures in day to day life as a

process of value addition.

Link to other subjects:

● Agriculture and Nutrition: The learner applies the knowledge on separating mixtures in agricultural processes like straining

milk, winnowing grains and straining honey.
